name: The Curse
source:
"THE CURSE" follows Avaline, a relatively new player in the world's most populated online game, caught in the middle of inscrutable interpersonal conflicts between her newfound in-game friend group.

[From [url=https://barroo.itch.io/the-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《诅咒》讲述了艾娃琳 (Avaline) 的故事，她是世界上人口最多的在线游戏中的一名相对较新的玩家，她陷入了她新发现的游戏内朋友群体之间难以理解的人际冲突之中。

[来自[url=https://barroo.itch.io/the-curse]itch.io[/url]]
